violated_contract: A first-match gateway must dispatch each authenticated endpoint through its identity owner before any overlapping public parameter route; a valid identity must reach the downstream service as a verified internal assertion.
canonical_prevention: Register related literal and parameter routes together with authenticated static routes first. Exercise the actual gateway fetch entry with valid, missing and rejected identity, signed downstream verification, and public/admin siblings. The 2026-09-04 local Android Cloudflare restoration incident hit public /v1/announcements/:announcementId before authenticated /pending and received 401 after successful JWT restoration.
